t: O My Allah! Preserve (the grace of) my face with easiness of life and do not disgrace my countenance with destitution, lest I may have to beg a livelihood from those who beg from from you, try to seek the favour of your evil creatures, engage myseld in praising those who give to me, and be tempted in abusing those who do not give to me, although behind all these you are the master of giving and denying. "Verily you over all things, are the All-powerful." (Qur'an, 66:8)
